content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RITES Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES Company Secretary recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the fees is 02 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Qualified Company Secretaries from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Company Secretary position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Company Secretary post is 43 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Company Secretary post, specifically for the Deputy General Manager (DGM) role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from INR 70,000 to INR 2,20,000 per month, depending on the specific post (DGM or JGM).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates are required to pay Rs. 600/- plus applicable taxes as the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for SC and ST candidates?
faq.answer: SC and ST candidates need to pay Rs. 300/- plus applicable taxes as the application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RITES Company Secretary recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Scrutiny followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article or from the RITES official website.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the RITES Company Secretary position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official RITES website or the provided 'Apply Online' link before the last date.
